_about: Plain names and page slugs for the items in USDA's daily pork report (LM_PK602), keyed on USDA's own description (runs of spaces made one). primal is the report table the item is listed in. scripts/snapshot.py adds any new item it meets with the same naming rules (pork_name); never change a slug once its page is live. es and slug_es are the Spanish name and page.
